card.desc: Something powering up. Rising, and it is going to end in something.
card.prompt: a science fiction energy weapon charging up, rising synthesised whine building in pitch and intensity, designed sound effect
card.negative: music, melody, speech, explosion, discharge, crowd, reverb
card.note: It must RISE and stop - pair with a discharge or it reads as an unresolved mistake.

peak_limited.why: audition copy had no peak ceiling; the film bus already limits to -3 dBTP
